tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Maxsun Terminator Z790M D5 ICE White DDR5 Motherboard is designed for high-performance gaming and productivity on Intel's 12th, 13th, and 14th Gen Core processors. Built on the Intel Z790 chipset, this stylish micro-ATX motherboard features next-gen DDR5 memory support, ultra-fast Wi-Fi 6 connectivity, PCIe 5.0 expansion, and a sleek ICE White armor design—perfect for clean, modern PC builds.

Ideal for gamers, content creators, and power users, the Maxsun Z790M delivers premium features like high-speed NVMe M.2 slots, reinforced PCIe slots, advanced thermal solutions, and robust power delivery. With its compact size and powerful specs, it's the perfect balance of style, stability, and speed.


Key Features:

  • Chipset: Intel Z790 – supports 12th, 13th, and 14th Gen Intel Core CPUs
  • Memory Support: DDR5 Dual-Channel, up to 7200+ MHz (OC)
  • Form Factor: Micro-ATX – compact and compatible with most PC cases
  • Wireless Connectivity: Built-in Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth 5.2
  • Expansion Slots: PCIe 5.0 x16 slot for high-end graphics cards
  • Storage Support: Dual M.2 NVMe SSD slots (PCIe Gen4), 4x SATA III
  • USB Ports: USB 3.2 Gen2 Type-C, USB 3.2 Gen1, and USB 2.0
  • Audio: High-definition 7.1 channel audio with premium capacitors
  • Cooling: Enhanced thermal armor with heatsinks and fan headers
  • Design: ICE White armor with RGB header support for custom lighting
